turns.input: Bram Kessel gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Bram Kessel reaches into a sack at his hip and pulls out a pair of worn but serviceable leather boots, extending them toward Nicco with flour-dusted hands. "Carrying these since yesterday," he says, his voice dropping to its quieter register. "Fellow my size owed me for a spoiled barrel. Took these instead—wrong size, wrong everything for me." He shifts his weight, the charcoal stub behind his ear catching the daylight. "You look like you could use proper footing. Take them."

Nicco accepts the boots.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
"You'll need them more than me," Nicco said, holding out the boots.

Bram Kessel's large moustache twitched. He looked down at the offered leather, then up at Nicco's face, then back at the boots with the rapid calculation of a man weighing quantities in his head.

"Need them?" His voice dropped to its quiet register, the one he used over money. "Fellow who owed me hasn't got a copper to his name. Boots were the only thing on him worth taking, and they're no use to me at all." He made no move to accept them, hands settling on his apron. "You keep proper footing, or don't. That's yours now. I'm not carrying debt twice for the same pair of shoes."
